messages.text:
Hi Hal,

Thanks for reaching out.

To answer your first question: yes, I bought this MGW310 directly from
HeliumDeploy. Because of a shipping delay on the original order, some of
the orders were upgraded to the 310 model, which is why I received the 310
instead of the WB200.

Regarding your second question: yes, this unit is also linked in the
GEODNET console.

Please let me know what the next steps are to process the replacement for
this faulty unit.

Best regards,

Imtiyaz M.

Hi Imtiyaz,

Thanks for confirming. That clears it up: the MGW310 came from us as the upgrade on your original order, and it's linked in GEODNET.

We've had this since October 29, so I'm sorry it has taken this long. Everything we need is on file now. That includes the Wingbits ticket ····, the HYFIX diagnosis of the range and aircraft fault, serial (number hidden), Wingbits serial (number hidden), and firmware MGW310-v2.0.51.

The team is reviewing the return now. They'll confirm the next steps by email shortly. You don't need to send anything else or go up on the roof in the meantime.

Best regards,
HeliumDeploy support
